timeline.text: Artem's blood sugar lived in its own app. Checking it from the kitchen, where the family looks at the calendar screen, meant stopping for a phone.
Now a small route on the same Cloudflare Worker pulls his level, trend and age onto a badge over the calendar tile.
Past fifteen minutes old, the badge turns grey instead of showing a number that might be wrong.
His sugar and trend now sit right there on the kiosk — never silently stale past fifteen minutes.
